column1: Frontiers: Title list for Open Access publishing
This title list reflects journal titles which allow Open Access publishing in the framework of the Consortium agreement.
Relevant date for article eligibility: acceptance date 01.01.2026-31.12.2026
Article quota: depending on institution's chosen model
See also second tab of this list for the Society Journals
Frontiers and Hosted Journals (last updated by Frontiers in January 2025)

As of December 2024, Frontiers has changed the price list currency from USD to CHF. Our institutional partners will see the APC price in CHF in the dashboard until an article is accepted. An accepted and approved article will be invoiced in the preferred currency.
